parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable manages which color will be reduced. Set to 0 is the blend color will be reduced and set to 1 is the base color will be reduced.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Dithering Texture
parameter.description: The loaded texture will represent "dithering"; the base luminance is divided into 64 levels, and a portion of the texture is assigned to each level. The texture must be 32x2048 pixels in size; for example, luminance at level 2 (on a scale of 0–63) will use the portion of the texture from 96 to 128 on the X-axis and from 0 to 32 on the Y-axis.

parameter.name: (RGB) Color
parameter.description: This variable specifies the color used for the light parts.

parameter.name: (RGB) Color Shadow
parameter.description: This variable specifies the color used for the dark parts.

parameter.name: Threshold
parameter.description: This variable defines the threshold at which the "light" portion begins and the "dark" portion ends.
